subject: Building end-to-end at CodeCones
body:
Hi CodeCones team,

The line in your Full Stack Developer opening about owning features end-to-end stuck with me. A lot of "full-stack" roles still mean working on a small piece of someone else's plan. I like being responsible for the whole thing, from the API design to the screen someone actually uses.

At Stride.AI, I worked across production backend services and complex frontend features, including AI workflows. I also built Captar because I wanted better control over what LLM agents can do: tool permissions, budgets, and traces instead of hoping everything behaves after the demo.

I noticed you emphasize human ownership of production decisions, which is a big part of how I like to work.

I'm based in India and saw this opening is remote-global. Are you considering engineers working from here? I'd be happy to share a couple of builds.

My work: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Devansh
